model: arable share of a source-pixel (~1.84 km) cell = lo + (hi - lo) / (1 + (S / S0)^k), S = slope of the cell surface in degrees
rule: GAEZ slope classes on 90 m: < 8 % 1.0, 8-16 % 0.6, 16-30 % 0.3, steeper 0.05 (Fischer et al. 2012)
earth_data: Copernicus GLO-90 DEM, 12 development + 12 blind 1-degree tiles (calibration/geography_control_20261107/plan_D1.json)
applies: atlases built on an eroded terrain file; atlases without one keep scripts/land_people.py ARABLE_BY_TIER
